title: Concept: Reflective invocation via getDeclaredMethod (java) — review required
description: In java, getDeclaredMethod resolves code by name at runtime. The remedy is a fixed allow-list of method names.
applicability: java runtime name resolution; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Selection of unintended code or classes when the name is attacker-influenced; MEDIUM because the call alone does not prove data flow.
